findings.summary: The forward-only remediation adds review, clear, apply_decision and confirm_payment while preserving all 11 existing actions; authorized B1 steps are no longer vocabulary-blocked.

findings.follow_up: Keep inactive, expired and future-dated cases as mandatory DENY regression tests.
findings.summary: The final forward-only authorization definition restores current_user_has_exact_processing_binding after the predecessor guard, so stale processing authority fails closed while exact assignee identity remains mandatory.

findings.follow_up: design decision; if rejection is required, add explicit transitions first.
findings.summary: Shipped B1 workflows define no reject/return transitions; reject/return are unreachable by design and B1_SPECIALIZED_ACTION_RPC_REQUIRED is dead under the shipped gate order.

findings.follow_up: ACL/read-path hardening candidates for a later track.
findings.summary: The three new hardening helpers (user_matches_workflow_runtime_step, is_current_user_dean_for_student, current_user_has_exact_processing_binding family) keep default PUBLIC EXECUTE; registrar/admin universal READ is not hardened; attachment RPC sqlstates are inconsistent.

findings.follow_up: production activation remains owned by the release process.
